# help create
create* - Create new entities such as virtual volumes and logical disks.
In each case type "help <command>" for detailed help.

    createcert        - create SSL certificate
    createcpg         - create a Common Provisioning Group (CPG)
    createdomain      - create a domain
    createdomainset   - create or add domains to a set of domains
    createfileshare   - create a fileshare and export it to a client
    createfilesystem  - create a filesystem of a specified size
    creategroupsv     - create consistent group snapshots of a list of VVs
    creategroupvvcopy - create consistent group physical copies of a list of
                        VVs
    createhost        - create or add paths to a system host
    createhostset     - create or add hosts to a set of hosts
    createmaint       - create a maintenance window record
    creatercopygroup  - create a group for Remote Copy
    creatercopytarget - create a target for Remote Copy
    createsched       - create a scheduled task
    createsharesetting - create a share setting from specified client
                        information
    createsnmpuser    - create a SNMPv3 user and key
    createspare       - create a spare chunklet(s)
    createsralertcrit - create a System Reporter threshold alert criterion
    createsv          - create snapshot volumes
    createuser        - create user accounts
    createvlun        - export a virtual volume as a SCSI LUN
    createvv          - create a virtual volume from a common provisioning
                        group
    createvvcopy      - copy a vv
    createvvolsc      - create a vVol Storage Container and all of its Protocol
                        Endpoints
    createvvset       - create or add VVs to a set of VVs

User supplied names for the create* commands are limited to alphanumeric
characters, period/dot, dash and underscore. Names cannot start with a "-".
